from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); this_year=now.year
print('this_year', this_year)

# Fetch all spotify recommendations (paginated)
page_limit=20
all_recs=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('recs_page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

print('total_recs', len(all_recs))
unique_song_ids=sorted({r['song_id'] for r in all_recs})
print('unique_song_ids', len(unique_song_ids))

# For each recommended song, fetch release_date and genre
selected=[]
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date=s.get('release_date')
    genre=s.get('genre')
    # Parse year from release_date
    rel_year=None
    if release_date:
        try:
            rel_year=int(str(release_date)[:4])
        except Exception as e:
            rel_year=None
    genre_l=(genre or '').lower()
    is_rnb = ('r&b' in genre_l) or ('rhythm and blues' in genre_l) or (genre_l.strip()=='r&b')
    is_this_year = (rel_year==this_year)
    if is_rnb and is_this_year:
        selected.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': s.get('title'), 'artist_names':[a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists',[])] , 'release_date': release_date, 'genre': genre})

print('selected_count', len(selected))
print('selected_song_ids', [x['song_id'] for x in selected])
print('selected_titles', [x['title'] for x in selected])

from datetime import datetime

# selected list computed earlier in prior execution cell
print('selected_count', len(selected))

# Create playlist (only if no exact existing match)
playlist_title='R&B Recommendation'
create_resp=apis.spotify.create_playlist(title=playlist_title, access_token=spotify_token)
print('create_resp', create_resp)
playlist_id=create_resp['playlist_id']
print('playlist_id', playlist_id)

# Add each selected song
for item in selected:
    sid=item['song_id']
    add_resp=apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('added', sid, 'resp', add_resp)

# Verify by fetching playlist
pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
print('playlist_title_verify', pl.get('title'))
print('playlist_song_count', len(pl.get('songs',[])))
print('playlist_song_ids', [s.get('id') for s in pl.get('songs',[])])

expected_ids=set([x['song_id'] for x in selected])
actual_ids=set([s.get('id') for s in pl.get('songs',[])])
print('expected_minus_actual', expected_ids-actual_ids)
print('actual_minus_expected', actual_ids-expected_ids)
